messages.text: I'm a serious buyer and ready to close quickly. For El Mesón de la Cava, I offer 45 P, which I think is a fair price. I'd be glad to hear your counter.
Hola. This one is in perfect condition. 100 P.
Thanks for the reply. I've moved up to 50 P as a show of good faith. Could you tell me what justifies a figure double that? I'm ready to close quickly if we can meet closer to the middle.
To show I mean business, I'm raising my offer to 58 P. Time is short, and I can close right now if you come down to a realistic counter. What is the lowest figure you can do?
I've moved a long way from where I started, and I'm now at 64 P. With the clock running down, no sale helps either of us, so I need a real counter from you to close this in time.
This is my last move before the deadline: 68 P. It's a solid step up from where I began, and with no sale you're left with nothing. Please take it now so we can close in time.
